title: Patient Financial Assistance Program Document Extensions: Allowance After a Recent Bedside or In-Home Collection
content:
**Stay allowance.** When the documents due date of a Patient Financial Assistance Program case is extended, a stay allowance is added to the extension's days before they are counted: a household with a facility bedside collection completed no more than 60 days before today adds the facility-stay days, 7 days; a household with no such bedside collection but a mobile in-home collection completed no more than 60 days before today adds the home-visit days, 4 days; any other household adds none.

## Questions the allowance answers

**Which collections count?**
Visits held in Specimen Collection Appointments as a Facility Bedside Collection Visit or a Mobile In-Home Collection Visit, in collected status. The visit's collected date is the day the collection was completed. Patient Service Center visits of any kind do not count.

**How are the 60 days counted?**
In calendar days from the collected date to today. A collection completed exactly 60 days before today counts; one completed 61 days before today does not.

**The household had both a bedside collection and an in-home collection in the last 60 days.**
The bedside collection governs: 7 days. The 4-day allowance applies only where there is no such bedside collection.

**The only recent bedside collection was 75 days ago, and an in-home collection was 30 days ago.**
The bedside collection is not within 60 days, so the in-home collection governs: 4 days.

## Dated cases (hypothetical; today 15 September 2026)

| Collection completed | Allowance |
|---|---|
| Facility bedside collection, collected 17 July 2026 (60 days) | 7 days |
| Facility bedside collection, collected 16 July 2026 (61 days); no other collection | None |
| Mobile in-home collection, collected 2 September 2026; no bedside collection | 4 days |
